product.title: Countryside Bike Tour from Amsterdam: a Windmill and Dutch Cheese

description.text: Explore the Dutch countryside on this guided bike tour from Amsterdam, mixing windmills, farmland, and UNESCO canal landscapes. The route visits Krijtmolen d'Admiraal, Irene Hoeve for cheese and clogs, plus villages such as Zunderdorp and Ransdorp. Standard bikes cover a shorter loop; electric bikes cover more ground for experienced cyclists. A local guide keeps the ride on countryside lanes rather than independent navigation. Stops include Krijtmolen d'Admiraal, Irene Hoeve Clogs and Cheese Shop, Zunderdorp, Ransdorp.
